The Commons PD-USGov-Military label for the 1943 federal map is not treated as erasing the David Rumsey Map Collection's required credit for this digitized scan. Preserve the complete provenance and required credit with redistributed derivatives.

source.colorPolicy: Preserve source RGB. No recoloring, inpainting, generative detail, or modern geography.

projection.method: Analytical inverse of three interrupted sinusoidal panels with hemisphere-specific central meridians and a calibrated page-tilt correction.
projection.polarPolicy: Every target pixel, including the polar rows, is sampled from the printed map. Longitude naturally collapses toward each printed pole apex; the source is never extended with a synthetic cap.

canonicalSeamFeather.policy: Source-derived multiband feather only: preserve high-frequency scan detail, balance the low-frequency paper tone on both sides, and crossfade only the six central 4K columns. No paint, inpainting, generated pixels, or modern geography.

digitizedParallelAnchors.note: Representative page-wide readings; local page tilt is modeled separately.
